plan: Given my private value of $19, I should bid below this amount to ensure a profit if I win. Bidding exactly $19 or more risks no profit or a loss if I win. To maximize profit, bid just below my value to avoid overpaying. Avoid dominated strategies like bidding above $44 (my value) or below $0 (non-competitive). This maximizes profit if I win, paying the third-highest bid, typically lower than my value.
